entries.title: I Samuel 30:1
segments: And it happened when David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had invaded the south and Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag, and burned it with fire.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:2
segments: And they had seized the women in it. They did not kill any, either small or great, but carried them away and went on their way.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:3
segments: And David and his men came to the city, and behold, [it was] burned with fire, and their wives and their sons and their daughters had been taken captives.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:4
segments: And David and the people with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:5
segments: And David's two wives had been seized, Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail, the [former] wife of Nabal of Carmel.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:6
segments: And it greatly distressed David, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, each one for his sons and for his daughters. But David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:7
segments: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, Please bring the ephod here to me. And Abiathar brought the ephod there to David.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:8
segments: And David inquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go after this troop? Shall I overtake them? And He answered him, Go! For you shall surely overtake and will without fail recover all.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:9
segments: So David went, he and the six hundred men that [were] with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:10
segments: But David pursued, he and four hundred men. For two hundred stayed behind, who were too exhausted to go over the brook Besor.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:11
segments: And they found an Egyptian in the field and brought him to David and gave him bread, and he ate. And they made him drink water.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:12
segments: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins. And when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him. For he had eaten no bread nor drunk water for three days and three nights.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:13
segments: And David said to him, Whose [are] you? And where do you come from? And he said, I am an Egyptian youth, servant to an Amalekite. And my master left me because three days ago I fell sick.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:14
segments: We raided the south of the Cherethites, and on that [belonging] to Judah, and on the south of Caleb. And we burned Ziklag with fire.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:15
segments: And David said to him, Can you bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear to me by God that you will neither kill me nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this company.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:16
segments: And when he had brought him down, behold, [they were] spread abroad on all the earth, eating and drinking and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines and out of the land of Judah.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:17
segments: And David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. And not a man of them escaped, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:18
segments: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away. And David rescued his two wives.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:19
segments: And nothing was lacking to them, from the small to the great, even to sons and daughters, and from the spoil, even to all that they had taken to themselves. David recovered all.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:20
segments: And David took all the flock, and the herd. They drove on before those cattle. And they said, This [is] David's spoil.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:21
segments: And David came to the two hundred who were too exhausted to follow David, whom they had made also to stay at the brook Besor. And they went out to meet David, and to meet the people with him. And David came up to the people, and greeted them.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:22
segments: And all the wicked men and [men] of Belial among the men who went with David answered and said, Because they did not go with us, we will not give them from a thing the spoil that we have seized, except to every man his wife and his sons. Let them take them, and go.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:23
segments: And David said, My brothers, you shall not do so with that which the LORD has given us. For He has protected us, and has delivered into our hand the company that came against us.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:24
segments: For who will listen to you in this matter? But as his part [is] that goes down to the battle, so [shall be] his part that stays by the stuff. They shall divide alike.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:25
segments: And it was [so], from that day forward he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

entries.title: I Samuel 30:26
segments: And David came to Ziklag, and sent some of the spoil to the elders of Judah, to his friends, saying, Behold, a present for you from the spoil of the enemies of the LORD;

entries.title: I Samuel 30:27
segments: to the ones in Bethel, and to the ones in Ramoth of the south, and to the ones in Jattir,

entries.title: I Samuel 30:28
segments: and to the ones in Aroer, and to the ones in Siphmoth, and to the ones in Eshtemoa,

entries.title: I Samuel 30:29
segments: and to the ones in Rachal, and to the ones in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to the ones in the cities of the Kenites,

entries.title: I Samuel 30:30
segments: and to the ones in Hormah, and to the ones in Chorashan, and to the ones in Athach,

entries.title: I Samuel 30:31
segments: and to the ones in Hebron, and to all the places where David had gone up and down, he and his men.
